evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: understanding that data reliability and clear cross-functional communication are vital to our velocity
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (data governance, testing frameworks, data lineage, data quality monitoring) appear alongside explicit velocity language ('vital to our velocity', 'short path from idea to action'), giving roughly equal weight and a mixed classification.
evidence.domain_risk: At Qred, we're building the world's best bank for small businesses
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Qred is a regulated bank (Qred Bank AB) whose data directly supports financial systems at scale, defaulting to high domain risk even though the JD language itself is not heavily compliance-focused.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Implement robust data governance standards, including testing frameworks, data cataloging, and clear data lineage
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools and practices (dbt, Redshift, IaC, data governance standards) appear directly in responsibilities, indicating an existing and growing but not yet fully mature data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Deploy scalable infrastructure updates using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools within our cloud environment
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some bullets are technically precise (ETL/ELT pipelines, IaC, dbt, Redshift) while others are generic boilerplate ('partner with analysts, engineers, and business leaders'), placing it as mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with analysts, engineers, and business leaders to align data delivery with critical commercial goals
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is framed around the data function itself (data architecture, governance, pipelines) serving internal engineering/analytics consumers rather than a specific external-facing business unit.
evidence.autonomy_level: you will own the end-to-end design and execution of our data architecture
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role explicitly grants ownership of end-to-end data architecture design and autonomy to bridge infrastructure with business impact, a strategic framing.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools, AI-assisted coding, or AI-consuming infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement robust data governance standards, including testing frameworks, data cataloging, and clear data lineage
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing frameworks and data governance are framed as something the candidate implements and owns, using an action verb, not just listed as a tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Implement robust data governance standards, including testing frameworks, data cataloging, and clear data lineage
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: data governance and reliability are stated concerns but framed in terms of engineering best practice and velocity rather than explicit regulatory/compliance risk language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines to automate high-quality data integration from diverse financial sources
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes designing new architecture ('own the end-to-end design') with optimizing existing pipelines, giving a mixed signal.
evidence.urgency: while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately
evidence.work_arrangement: we have an office-first approach... we have the option of working remotely one day per week
